method: Compiled both Python fences, executed normalized usage arithmetic, and mocked the API transport. Regression cases verified that token usage is captured before rejecting non-end_turn and empty-text responses, preserving known incurred usage for partial reconciliation. Reviewed current Anthropic Messages usage fields, Anthropic prompt caching, and DeepSeek compatibility docs. No provider call was made.
limitations: The two 2026-10-09 historical cost ratios remain aggregate summaries without recoverable per-call requests/responses, scorer records, exact model snapshot or billing data; they were not reproduced.

Constructed usage responses verify local aggregation and stop-reason handling only; they do not establish model quality, provider billing or production behavior. Usage capture is process-local, not durable; crashes and responses without valid usage can still leave the final cost unknown.
The sample provider runner is serialized, does not score answer quality, and does not measure latency or parallel execution.
Anthropic usage and prompt-cache semantics are endpoint-specific. DeepSeek documents cache_control as ignored for its Anthropic-compatible API; no provider endpoint was queried in this audit.
